description.value:
Garleans possess a biological inability to wield magic directly, but have mastered magitek – blending technology and ceruleum to replicate magic.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Garleans gain +2 Constitution and +2 Intelligence, but suffer a –2 penalty to Wisdom.
  • Type: Garleans are Humanoid creatures with the garlean subtype.
  • Size: Garleans are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
  • Base Speed: Garleans have a base speed of 30 feet.
  • Languages: Garleans begin play speaking Common. Garleans with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Elvaan, Galkan, Goblin, Lalafellan, and Mithran.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Fearless: Garleans gain a +2 racial bonus on all saving throws against fear effects.
  • Hardy: Garleans gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against poison, spells, and spell-like abilities.
  • Magitek Training: Garleans gain a +4 dodge bonus to AC against constructs of the robot subtype and magiteks.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Keen Senses: Garleans receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.
  • Noble Upbringing: Garleans receive a +2 bonus on Knowledge (nobility) and Knowledge (history), treated as class skills.
  • Sovereignty of The Nation: Garleans can gain Firearms (Simple) proficiency or a single Gun Arm Exotic Weapon Proficiency.
  • Technologically Advanced: Garleans gain a +2 racial bonus on Knowledge (Technology), Repair, and one Craft skill.

Magical Racial Traits

  • Third Eye (Su): Garleans can use detect magic at will as a spell-like ability.

Weakness Racial Traits

  • Magic Ineptitude: Garleans are inept with magic. They cannot obtain a magic pool nor use spell-trigger/completion/command word activated items.
